stem: Voltmarkt's CFO asks: "If we leave out the stores we opened or closed, are our stores selling more than a year ago?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: Net revenue / orders, against the same month a year ago
100 × transactions / visits, against a year ago
Growth on a year ago, counting every store, including new and closed ones
Growth on a year ago, counting only stores that traded in both periods
